a.title: Google admits AI search makes less money, but it's fixing that with more ads

b.lede: Net profit slid 25% from a year earlier to $26.2bn, well short of expectations, though revenue rose to $127.6bn Shares in the Google parent Alphabet fell double digits Wednesday evening into Thursday trading, erasing hundreds of billions of dollars in stock market value from the $4tn tech giant. The company had reported lower-than-expected profit and a slowdown in its advertising
b.title: Google owner Alphabet loses $500bn in market value after profit disappoints Wall Street
